newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares hit record high on domestic buying.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares hit record high on domestic buying.

text.p: 1130 GMT - Portuguese shares rose strongly and the PSI20 index broke briefly through the 8,000-point barrier to hit a record 8,001.02 as domestic funds and individual investors continued their blue-chip buying spree.
*Dealers said prices could go slightly higher but warned that profit-taking was likely to set in soon.
*"There is talk of profit-taking but the mood remains bullish," said one trader.
*"Volume is quite low but the buying is steady. There is very good demand for bank shares, especially those linked to (businessman) Antonio Champalimaud," another dealer said.
*Champalimaud's BTA jumped 123 escudos to 3,425 on volume of 265,667 while BPSM climbed 33 esc to 1,837 with 338,395 shares traded.
*EDP bucked the trend, slipping five esc to 3,332 on turnover of 290,982.
